findings.rule: Reviewer B brief: nothing that a W4 screen would reuse may be deleted. PLAN.md section 2 rewrites ImportResumeNavKey as Reading (W4-A2), and fix #241/#246 (PR #251) lives in the deleted code.
findings.trigger: The deleted ImportResumeViewModel.onParsed/withFreshFactIds/userFacts was the only code that saves a parsed resume. It re-ids every parsed entry through FactIdAllocator against the kept facts, marks entries IMPORTED and unconfirmed, keeps non-IMPORTED user facts and replaces earlier imported ones. ImportResumeIdCollisionTest, ImportResumeKeptEntriesTest and ImportedContinuationTest go with it, and no core/domain use case does this job (FactIdAllocator is used only by AddUserStatedFact(s)UseCase). The W4-A2 issue names only ResumeTextParser. A Reading screen built from that brief that saves parser output directly brings back #241 (parsed ids collide with user-stated fact ids), and a re-upload drops the user's own facts.
findings.title: The parse-and-save rules for imported resumes (#241 ids, kept user facts) have no surviving home or test, and W4-A2 does not carry them
findings.proof: Port ImportResumeIdCollisionTest and ImportResumeKeptEntriesTest (from main) to the W4-A2 Reading ViewModel or to a new core/domain import use case. Disposition: add these rules and the two tests to the W4-A2 issue. A code change in this PR is not needed, because the issue requires deleting the ViewModel.
